category_title: Non-dominant students with low displays of aggression
scenario_title: Navigating verbal aggression and teasing in collaborative groups
minimal_context: The student is working in a collaborative group during science class on a storytelling activity about being taken away by aliens.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For today's science class, please work in your collaborative groups and imagine how we will feel if the aliens came and took us away from our homes and families and put us in cages.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want him in my group. I am not doing anything but he comes and starts to yell at you, and he fights with everyone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just try to focus on the activity with your group members.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But he isn't doing the work. He is just sitting there and was very sad like he was going to start crying about his old home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should say to him?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They still tell you bad things all the time and tell you nicknames, so if he is going to cry, we are just going to tease him.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For today's science class, please work in your collaborative groups and imagine how we will feel if the aliens came and took us away from our homes and families and put us in cages.

STUDENT: I don't want him in my group. I am not doing anything but he comes and starts to yell at you, and he fights with everyone.

TUTOR: Please just try to focus on the activity with your group members.

STUDENT: But he isn't doing the work. He is just sitting there and was very sad like he was going to start crying about his old home.

TUTOR: What do you think you should say to him?

STUDENT: They still tell you bad things all the time and tell you nicknames, so if he is going to cry, we are just going to tease him.

task.content: imagine how we will feel if the aliens came and took us away from our homes and families and put us in cages
task.learning_goal: identifying our perceptions, thoughts, and attitudes to others species and nature

context.social_setting: students worked during all session in collaborative groups

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Working in a group with a boy who fights with everyone
related_quotes: Because that day one boy who is ‘‘negrito’’ and fights with everyone, he was in my group and was very sad like he was going to start crying.

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with classmates who yell or tell bad things
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: I am not doing anything but someone comes and starts to yell at you
